title: Identify unchanged bonds
statement:
In hydrogenation of ethene to ethane, which bond count appears unchanged on both sides and can cancel in the average model?

[_]{a}

choices: All six product C–H bonds cancel.
explanations: The common set occurs on both sides.
The product has a C–C single bond.
Only four occur on the reactant side.

hints: Keep only the net formation of two C–H bonds after cancellation.
solution: Ethene has four C–H bonds. Ethane has six C–H bonds. Keep only the net formation of two C–H bonds after cancellation. The common set occurs on both sides.
